basic_info.description: An incredible value, this sleek and sophisticated 1 bedroom, 1.5-bath condo-loft boasts 17 foot ceilings and dramatic city views on 2 floors. Thoughtful upgrades throughout including SOMFY automatic custom shades, custom lighting, and wide-plank mahogany wood floors. The open floor plan showcases the spacious living room, dining area, and well-appointed kitchen. Adjacent to the upstairs bedroom, there's a home office equipped with custom storage by IP2 ideal for modern living. 1-car parking and in-unit laundry are also included. Walk to world-class restaurants, nightlife, AT&T Park, MOMA and more.
